children: Australian wages grew at their fastest pace in nearly three years in the September quarter, adding to signs that the labour market remained tight and supporting the case for higher interest rates to rein in inflation.

Figures from the Australian Bureau of Statistics showed on Wednesday its wage price index rose 1.1% in the September quarter, the highest since late 2023. That exceeded analyst forecasts for a rise of 0.9%.
Annual pay growth picked up to 3.5%, from 3.2% the previous quarter.
